column3: MT 13:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1 (vv. 5–6 together are MT 13:6). NASB sets the title in braces before verse 1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; “by day” is rendered “all the day.”
Close to the Hebrew; “sleep the death” is rendered “sleep the sleep of death.”
Close to the Hebrew; “lest” is rendered “And.”
Close to the Hebrew; “covenant loyalty” is rendered “lovingkindness.”
